expected_findings.description: When `aid_keep == 0`, the slice `aid[-aid_keep:]` incorrectly produces the full aid string (not empty) because Python treats `-0` as `0`; this is a latent defect though harmless in current use where aid is always non-empty.
The test assertion `<= 64` should be `== 64` to prevent future off-by-one regressions, since the output is always exactly 64.
The determinism test `f(a,b) == f(a,b)` is trivially true for pure functions; should store the result and compare against a literal to rule out hidden mutability.
The `budget` comment should clarify that the `-1` accounts for the `-` separator before the digest, not for the `:`.
